milestones.name: Baseline
milestones.scope: Real iOS Swift app with login, projects, entries, offline draft, photos
milestones.requiredEvidence: Source tag, physical-device recording, baseline timings, saved user records, signed test build.

milestones.name: Engine adoption
milestones.scope: Same iOS flows use public MixerCore/UI in native mode
milestones.requiredEvidence: Behavior comparison, migration report, no data loss, no private SDK imports.

milestones.name: Shared Android
milestones.scope: Shared Swift flows work on physical Android and iOS
milestones.requiredEvidence: Same scenario results, device versions, source-sharing report, native platform differences documented.

milestones.name: Interpreted parity
milestones.scope: Same feature module runs through our VM on both platforms
milestones.requiredEvidence: Native/interpreted differential tests, performance report, original Swift crash/source mapping.

milestones.name: OTA delivery
milestones.scope: Existing installed binaries receive a real UI and logic fix
milestones.requiredEvidence: Before/after source and recordings, immutable artifact IDs, runtime fingerprints, no binary reinstall.

milestones.name: Recovery
milestones.requiredEvidence: Controlled test-channel fault receipts, offline relaunch, preserved drafts/records, no repeat-crash loop.

milestones.name: Cloud workflow
milestones.scope: App builds, signs, distributes, updates, and rolls back through our hosted service
milestones.requiredEvidence: Public CLI/API logs, isolated build provenance, store processing/testing receipts, usage/billing audit.

milestones.name: Production use
milestones.scope: Transparently reviewed iOS and Android store apps used for real work
milestones.requiredEvidence: Store links/versions, actual tester/customer activity, real product changes, support history.

milestones.name: Sustained confidence
milestones.scope: Repeated real production use, updates, and recovery across the required scenario corpus
milestones.requiredEvidence: Incident history, performance trends, latest 20-change coverage report, practiced recovery, export build.
